summary: Global Net Lease filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement adding Lucid Capital Markets as an agent and forward purchaser under its existing $300 million ATM equity offering sales agreement. The original sales agreement is dated November 7, 2025, and Lucid was added via Amendment No. 1 on November 6, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM program update, not a special situation. No price per share, premium, or closing date is stated. Watch only for dilution and overhang from any future at-the-market share sales.
